% thematic fixture (a) — math inside \halign cells.
% Pins the historically weakest cross-construct seam (,
%): a text \halign whose cells contain inline $...$ math.
% Each cell routes its $...$ through the math branch inside the alignment
% v-template, so the column atoms (Ord/Bin/Rel spacing) AND the row baselines
% (§807 interline glue) must byte-compare to MiKTeX within the
% tolerance (+/-0.5pt V / +/-0.1pt H).
\hsize=6.5in
\vsize=8.9in
\nopagenumbers
\normalbaselines
\halign{$#$\hfil&\quad$#$\hfil\cr
  a+b&x=y\cr
  c-d&\alpha\beta\cr
  e+f&z=w\cr}
\bye
